mods.author: simplysanatori
mods.notes: Removes the glow and doubled outlines around characters at higher internal resolutions.

mods.name: Single Screen Experience
mods.title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time 3D
mods.author: M-1
mods.notes: Puts the whole game on one screen with no touch screen needed, adds quality-of-life changes and an HD font, for the USA, Europe and Japan versions. It replaces any other code patch for the game, such as Ocarina ReFramed. Its optional HD UI textures are not installed.

mods.notes: Covers all regions (North America, Europe, Japan, Korea, Taiwan); the folder for the game's own title ID is used. Replaces any other code patch for the game.

mods.name: Vanilla+ Link Remodel
mods.title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time 3D
mods.author: HugAMuffin
mods.notes: Replaces Link and the models of his items and equipment with more detailed ones, keeping the original texture layout so texture mods still fit. The files are not tied to a region, and the page names no region, so treat the Europe and Japan versions as untested. It replaces the same model files as Better Link and Better Remaster Experience, so use only one of them.

mods.name: Better Link v3
mods.title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time 3D
mods.author: skilarbabcock
mods.notes: Remodels Link, the Master Sword and other equipment, with a build for each region. The USA install is the randomizer-friendly build, though the author says the randomizer's colour options do not work with it. It replaces the same model files as Vanilla+ and Better Remaster Experience, so use only one of them.

mods.name: Better Link v3 (Longer Sword Hitbox)
mods.title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time 3D
mods.author: skilarbabcock
mods.notes: The same Better Link v3 models for the USA version, with a code patch that lengthens Link's sword hitbox. The code patch replaces any other one for the game, such as Single Screen Experience's, so this suits a game without it.

mods.name: Better Remaster Experience
mods.title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time 3D
mods.author: Redstormmars
mods.notes: Brings back looks from the N64 game, with a darker Forest Temple, a revised Link and changed scenes and models, for the USA and Europe versions. Its New 3DS C-stick camera patch (code.ips and exheader.bin) is not installed, so it does not clash with Single Screen Experience. It replaces the same model files as Vanilla+ and Better Link, so use only one of them.

mods.name: Dirtier Stock Pot Inn
mods.title: The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask 3D
mods.author: TheTigershark
mods.notes: Makes the Stock Pot Inn dirtier and more run down, closer to the N64 version, by replacing its scene files. It is a port of the PC mod by Takeshre. The author names the Europe and USA versions.

mods.name: The Legend of Lillie
mods.title: The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask 3D
mods.author: Camyoshi
mods.notes: Replaces Link and his four masked forms with Lillie from Pokemon Sun and Moon, plus new expressions, text and voice clips. It is for the USA version only, since the changed dialogue works only there. It replaces Link's model files, so it clashes with other Link-model mods.

mods.name: CD Quality Soundtrack
mods.title: Kid Icarus: Uprising
mods.author: Zara Nerd
mods.notes: Replaces the music with 44.1 kHz versions cut from a lossless album rip, for the USA version. Two tracks (the Vault theme and the one after Dark Pit joins in Chapter 21) are unchanged, and some tracks may click or pop where they loop. The download is about 650 MB.

mods.name: Dark Pit Over Pit
mods.title: Kid Icarus: Uprising
mods.author: M-1
mods.notes: Puts Dark Pit's textures over Pit's. It is for the USA version only, since the file sits in a US-named folder. The author says it is safe for online play.

mods.name: Even Easier Zoom + Evac
mods.title: Dragon Quest VIII: Journey of the Cursed King
mods.author: AlyenOllie
mods.notes: Lets every party member use Zoom and Evac from level 1 at 0 MP, which makes Chimaera Wings pointless. The Hero's Zoom skill slot now gives 5 maximum HP instead. It replaces skill and parameter files, so it can clash with other gameplay mods.

mods.name: Guest Party Member Name Fix
mods.title: Dragon Quest VIII: Journey of the Cursed King
mods.author: AlyenOllie
mods.notes: Fixes the names of guest party members and fusion monsters in the battle display, so Prince Charmles is no longer called Damon. It replaces the monster table and word tables, so it can clash with other mods that edit them.

mods.name: Playable Evil Jessica
mods.title: Dragon Quest VIII: Journey of the Cursed King
mods.author: AlyenOllie
mods.notes: Retextures Jessica with Evil Jessica's textures, including evil versions of her alternate costumes. It may not work with the HD texture pack.

mods.name: Sonic
mods.title: Mario Kart 7
mods.author: Blurro
mods.notes: Replaces Donkey Kong with Sonic: the driver, kart, emblem, voice clips and menu art (North America, Europe and Japan). It works on the unmodified game and does not need CTGP-7. Donkey Kong is gone while it is installed; the Christmas hat version and the CTGP-7 pack are not installed.

mods.name: White Screen Fix
mods.title: Super Mario 3D Land
mods.author: ffman1985
mods.notes: Stops the game crashing to a white screen after beating Bowser in World 8, by removing the shining-star effect from the file select layout (North America only). The shining stars still show on the save's info page.

mods.name: New Super Mario 3D Land
mods.title: Super Mario 3D Land
mods.author: Nick64 Mods
mods.notes: Four new worlds with custom levels, textures and music. The author tested it on a real 3DS and says it should work in an emulator; use a new save. Replaces other Super Mario 3D Land level mods, which edit the same files.

mods.name: Super Mario Escape
mods.title: Super Mario 3D Land
mods.author: Nick64 Mods
mods.notes: A new adventure of about one and a half worlds, with changed Toad Houses and item boxes and a secret stage. Use a new save. Replaces other Super Mario 3D Land level mods, which edit the same files.

mods.name: Super Mario Expedition
mods.title: Super Mario 3D Land
mods.author: Cy8ro
mods.notes: A one-world mod built around exploration. Its optional custom world map file (GameSystemDataTable.szs) is not installed, since it needs a fresh save. Replaces other Super Mario 3D Land level mods, which edit the same files.

mods.name: Super Mario Expedition 2
mods.title: Super Mario 3D Land
mods.author: Cy8ro
mods.notes: A one-world sequel to Super Mario Expedition with five new levels and a credits level, plus its own title logo and music. Replaces other Super Mario 3D Land level mods, which edit the same files.

mods.title: Fire Emblem Fates
mods.author: Moonling

It is a code patch, so it replaces any other code patch for the game. Unofficial Gay Fates already includes this on the North America and Europe Special Edition.

mods.name: Fates Icon Project
mods.title: Fire Emblem Fates
mods.author: Moonling
mods.notes: Gives every item its own hand-made icon, over 200 in all. This is the plain version; the page does not name a region. It replaces GameData.bin.lz, so it clashes with Unofficial Gay Fates, whose own icon packs on the page are not installed.

mods.name: Fates Icon Project (Weapon Triangle)
mods.title: Fire Emblem Fates
mods.author: Moonling
mods.notes: The Fates Icon Project with a weapon triangle background behind each icon. The page does not name a region. It replaces GameData.bin.lz, so it clashes with Unofficial Gay Fates and with the plain icon version.

mods.name: Unofficial Gay Fates
mods.title: Fire Emblem Fates
mods.author: Milfnuggy
mods.notes: A standalone fan expansion with about a thousand same-sex and platonic supports and custom endings, for every Fates edition. On the Special Edition in North America and Europe it ships its own code patch, so it replaces other code patches; the other editions need the Paralogue Unlocker. On a Europe copy in another language than English, rename romfs/m/@U to your language letter. The optional add-ons are not installed.

mods.title: Fire Emblem Echoes: Shadows of Valentia
mods.author: Oersted
mods.notes: Adds bosses that appear only the first time you enter Ram Woods and Novis Cemetery, so it needs a new save. The author lists North America, Korea and the Chinese version (also the Japan ID); the Europe version is not listed. Some of the new units reuse base textures.
